noIndicators: No indicators measured — unknown, not poor health.
assessmentDesc: A transparent profile of soil functions — deliberately no single “soil health score” (no validated weighting methodology).
profileDesc: Depth-explicit layers — actual sampled intervals, never snapped to a standard grid. Overlaps are never merged; gaps are never interpolated.
noMeasurements: No soil measurements yet — import a laboratory report or record a sampling event below.
socDesc: FAO GSOC MRV layer formula — refused, never guessed, when an input is missing. Fine-earth bulk density is never coarse-fragment corrected twice.
budgetDesc: Balance over DOCUMENTED flows only. Missing flows (leaching, volatilization, …) are listed — never assumed zero. A partial balance is never a measured soil stock change.
labImportDesc: CSV soil-lab reports mapped onto the canonical schema — depth validation, detection limits preserved (never zero-filled), per-row rejected-row report, idempotent by file checksum.
readinessDesc: Qualitative, decision-linked ranking — which measurement would unblock which decision. No invented costs or benefits.
noPriorities: No priority gaps identified from the current decision surface.
selectFieldPrompt: Select a field to explore its soil intelligence.
methodologyDesc: Every calculation cites its published method; unverified methods are listed as not implemented — never approximated.
